headline: Approved several Section J school policies including JFABD, JFABE, JFABF, JFBB, and JHD; held or removed others.
summary: The subcommittee approved minutes from the June 11, June 17, and June 25, 2026 meetings by 3-0 votes. It reviewed Section I policies on topics such as advertising, social media, and homework, and reviewed Section J policies, approving some, placing others on hold, and removing some.
decisions: Policy JF was held for review from FRC.
Policy JFABC was held contingent on title.
Policy JH was held for admin review.
Policy JHAA will be re-located to the handbook.
Policy JHAB was removed due to redundancy.
